title: Effects of nucleation on solvate and polymorph control – evaporative crystallization of taltirelin

Hydrated α- and β-forms were obtained from aqueous solvents, whereas the anhydrous γ-form was first identified from organic solvents. The proposed dimensionless plotting method represents a promising and effective approach for polymorph screening.
